metaTitle: How to Choose an Insulated Water Bottle
description: Choose an insulated water bottle by vacuum insulation, size, lid and mouth design, materials and cleaning, with sizing tables for hiking and camping.
directAnswer: Choose a double-wall vacuum stainless steel bottle sized to your longest stretch between refills, typically 24 to 32 ounces for hiking, with a leak-proof lid and a wide mouth for ice and cleaning. Expect cold for 12 to 24 hours.
